_comment: R32 for track V: one single-edit mutant per invariant the V1 cases claim, each with the case names that must catch it on an assertion. Run with `node tests/v/run-mutants.mjs`. A survivor, a stale `find`, a declared case that dies by exception, or a whole test file failing to load each fail the run. The areas the brief names are ALLOW-*/SIZE-*/CURSOR-*/MODEL-*/TRIM-*/ANCHOR-*/HREF-* (filter allowlist and URL state), AVAIL-*/STATUS-*/EMPTY-*/ERROR-*/JOIN-*/SIGNAL-*/SUSPEND-*/KEYS-*/FIRST-* (presentation), and STALE-*/TRACK-* (the stale-response guard).
